node.label: Pappenheimer bodies
node.definition: A type of erythrocyte inclusion characterized by basophilic stippling of erythrocytes, that is, by numerous very small coarse or fine blue granules within the cytoplasm with the additional stipulation that the stippled particles are due to iron granules (demonstrable by the Prussian blue stain).

evidence.snippet: Anemia, sideroblastic, and spinocerebellar ataxia: Pappenheimer bodies (frequency 3/3) [PCS]
X-linked sideroblastic anemia and spinocerebellar ataxia: Pappenheimer bodies (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
